newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - KLM shines among NY ADRs.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - KLM shines among NY ADRs.

text.p: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV stood out among foreign shares in New York on Monday, boosted by talk of a share buyback.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) generally rose along with the larger market. "Everything is up on the back of New York doing well," one trader said.

KLM rose 1-5/8 to 26-5/8 after the airline said it was in early talks with the Dutch government on a partial buyback of the state's 38.2 percent stake in the airline. The move is seen as making KLM more attractive in an alliance with another carrier.

Among other European shares, Britain's Enterprise Oil Plc rose 1-3/8 to a 12-month high of 30-3/8 on a report in the Financial Times newspaper said it could be re-rated after a rumored North Sea oil acquisition.
British pharmaceuticals company Glaxo Wellcome Plc rose 5/8 to 33-3/8 after brokerage ABN AMRO Hoare Govett made positive comments about the stock.

Among Latin American shares, Venezuelan telephone company CANTV fell 3/8 to 25-1/2 in heavy mid-morning trade of seven million shares. The company began trade on Friday in New York bolstered by portfolio managers seeking the stock as a foothold in the Venezuelan market.
Decliners led advancers by a margin of 218 to 211 on an index of 807 ADRs. Volume was 19.5 million shares at mid- morning.
